meaning: A word you use with "I" to tell about yourself.
Means "one." We use it before words that start with a, e, i, o, u sounds.
Tells where or when something is.

example: She is as tall as her brother.

meaning: A word we put before a thing we are talking about.
Means you are able to do something.
A small furry pet that says "meow."
Means you owned or held something before.
The color of a strawberry or a fire truck.

example: If it rains, we will stay inside.

meaning: Tells about one person or thing right now.

example: I got a gift for my birthday.

meaning: To allow someone to do something.
example: Mom let me stay up late.
The fish is in the bowl.

meaning: Means you made something happen before.
A wild animal like a dog with a bushy orange tail.
example: The fox ran into the woods.
The bird sat on top of the tree.
My socks got wet in the rain.
I found a ball and kicked it.

meaning: A word for a boy or man.
A furry pet that barks and wags its tail.
example: My dog loves to play fetch.

meaning: To not move or keep going.
To receive or go and bring something.
A word that means "okay" or "I agree."
Belonging to a boy or man.
Very far from one end to the other.
Tells about one thing in the past.
Looked at something before. Also a tool that cuts wood.

example: I ride the bus to school.

meaning: Means "one." We use it before a thing.
To move from one place to another.
A word you use for yourself.
A word we say when we are surprised.
A word for me and other people.
The big bright star in the sky that gives us light.

example: I ate a slice of pizza.
The cup is on the table.

meaning: Something that makes you happy and having a good time.
example: The party was so much fun.

meaning: To move your legs very fast.
A word for a boy or man.
A word for me and other people together.

example: I do my chores every day.
I like apples, but not pears.

meaning: A big vehicle that carries heavy things.
A word that tells what someone is or will become.

meaning: A word you use for yourself.
A question word asking for a reason.
A word for a girl or woman.
A question word asking about a thing.
What someone or something is called.

example: I have five fingers on one hand.

meaning: A word for more than one thing right now.

example: Do you want milk or juice?

meaning: The time when the sun is up.
Water that falls from the clouds.
A machine with wheels that people ride in.
Meant to be given to someone.
How to do something or how to get somewhere.
To have fun with games or toys.
To rest flat. Also, to say something that is not true.
example: I lie down on my bed.
My friend came to my house.
Wash your hands before you eat.
The car drove down the road.

meaning: A round fruit, and also the color of that fruit.
Red, blue, and green are each a color.

example: The teacher says to sit down.

meaning: Moved fast with your legs before.
example: The dog ran after the ball.

meaning: The part behind you. Also, to return.

example: The jet flew high in the sky.

meaning: Tells about something that is going to happen.
Something you wear on your head.
example: I wear a hat in the sun.

meaning: The darkest color, like the night sky.
In a good way. Also a deep hole for water.

example: First we eat, then we play.

meaning: Land that rises up, smaller than a mountain.
A word to point at something.
The opposite of right. Also, went away.
A word for other people or things.
Smooth and even, with no bumps.
The top part of your body with your eyes and mouth.
example: I wear a hat on my head.

meaning: A word to point at something close.
The person someone is talking to.

example: I am giving Mom a card.
The toys are in the box.

meaning: To make something into pieces with scissors or a knife.
The part of your body at the end of your leg that you stand on.
A round toy you can throw, kick, or bounce.

example: My mom gives the best hugs.

meaning: To shout to someone or talk on the phone.
To push off the ground into the air.

example: It is such a nice day.

meaning: What we eat to grow strong.
To use your eyes to see.
To drop down. Also the season when leaves drop.
The meal we eat in the middle of the day.
The short, thick finger on your hand.
The big ball in the sky that goes around the Earth. We often see it at night.

example: I took my book to school.

meaning: To move on your feet, slower than running.
example: We walk the dog every day.

meaning: To press something away from you.
To go from one place to another.
Before all the others; number one.
A word for a girl or woman.
A tiny bug that lives in a group.

My favorite toy is a teddy bear.

meaning: A stick to hit a ball. Also a flying animal.
example: He hit the ball with a bat.

meaning: An animal with feathers and wings.

example: My house has a red door.
The puppy filled us with joy.
Put the apples in the bag.

meaning: To move around. Also, a chance to go.
Tells about more than one thing in the past.
Shaped like a circle or ball.
A small round piece of metal money.
example: I put a coin in my piggy bank.

meaning: A question word about a place.
Do, for one person or thing.
To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
To sit on something that moves.

example: I made a card for Mom.

meaning: To look at words and understand them.

example: The cat sat on the mat.

meaning: A ride with two wheels and pedals.

meaning: At the end; after all others.

example: He was mad when he lost.

meaning: What a clock shows. Also when something happens.

example: A horse is bigger than a dog.

I wore a coat because it was cold.

meaning: The sound you make when something is funny.

example: I go to bed at eight.

meaning: To rest on a chair or the floor.

example: I ate a bit of cake.

meaning: Close to the ground; not high.
An animal that lives with you.

example: I read to the end of the book.

meaning: To touch something hard and fast.
A plate or bowl for food.
example: Put the dish in the sink.

meaning: The body part you use to walk.

example: I want less ice in my drink.

meaning: To swallow water, milk, or juice.
To have something in your brain.
The color of chocolate or dirt.
To do something nice to make a job easier for someone.
A small unit to measure how long something is.
example: The bug is one inch long.

meaning: A question word about the way something happens.
example: How do you make a kite?
There are seven days in a week.

meaning: Me, with no help from anyone else.
example: I made it all by myself.

meaning: A question word about a person.
A container made of woven strips.
example: Put the eggs in the basket.
I felt sad when it rained.
The fat pig rolled in the mud.
The frog jumped into the pond.

meaning: To tap gently with your hand.
Washing your body in a tub of water.
example: I take a bath at night.

meaning: A drawing that shows where places are.
example: We used a map to find the park.
The ball sank to the bottom.

meaning: A cloth with colors that stands for a country or group.
example: The flag waved in the wind.

meaning: Made music with your voice before.

example: Dad cooked eggs in a pan.

meaning: A girl who has the same mom or dad as you.
To tell someone you are happy for what they did.
The part at the end of your arm with fingers.
Was able to. We also use it to ask nicely.
Shows what someone wants or might do.
Means it is a good idea to do something.
To touch, or to have a feeling inside.

example: We go to school five days a week.

meaning: To do something with a thing.
Loved or very special to you. We also write it at the start of a letter.

example: Lay the blanket on the grass.

meaning: A tall plant with a trunk and branches.
example: The bird is in the tree.

meaning: A sweet baked treat for parties.
Means you are allowed. Also a month.
To rest with your eyes closed.
The left or right part of something.
A color made from black and white.
To see someone for the first time, or get together.
To put letters and words on paper.
A form of "be" we use after have, has, or had.

meaning: Someone you like and who likes you.
Has lived a long time; not new.
To do your best to do something.
To pay money to get something.
example: We buy food at the store.

meaning: The soft edge of your mouth.
example: I put lip balm on my lip.

meaning: To make a hole in the ground.
The part that holds your head to your body.
example: A giraffe has a long neck.

meaning: To come in first in a game.
example: I hope our team will win.

meaning: A small animal that hops, lives near water, and says "ribbit."
example: The frog jumped into the pond.
My job is to feed the cat.

meaning: Number two in line. Also a tiny bit of time.
To choose. Or to pull off, like a flower.

example: I stayed home because I was sick.

meaning: A white drink that often comes from cows.
To jump on one foot, or like a bunny.
An animal that swims and lives in water.
example: The fish swam in the pond.

meaning: A small container to drink from.
Nice and caring. Also means a type of something.
A boy who is someone's child.
